objects.name: Analytic 1686
objects.description: For iOS, detect Ptrace System Calls by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Host Status via Apple MDM [DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries]; Network Traffic Flow via Apple Network Extension / Enterprise VPN [NEFilterFlow / per-app VPN / secure-web-gateway flow metadata]; Process Access via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: kernel log at level=fault referencing task_for_pid, mach_vm_write, or get-task-allow outside developer build on SUPERVISED device — Apple Unified Log kernel subsystem records these violations at fault level; supervised MDM with Unified Log ]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.
